title: Azure Data & AI Day GTA
description:
A full day of Fabric, Azure OpenAI and data platform sessions from local MVPs, with a hands-on lab track. Bring a laptop with an Azure subscription for the labs; trial credits are available at the door.

- Two tracks: talks on the main stage, labs in Hall B
- Lunch and coffee included; vegetarian, vegan and halal options
- Step-free access from the Square One transit terminal

venue.name: Living Arts Centre
venue.travelNotes: Step-free access from the Square One transit terminal

stream.label: Livestream available
stream.note: Keynote and main-stage sessions; labs are in person only

price.label: $49 · includes lunch
price.note: Student tickets $15 with a valid ID

agenda.title: Keynote: Fabric one year later — Priya Natarajan
Grounding Azure OpenAI on your lakehouse — Aisha Rahman
Lab: build a real-time dashboard with Eventstream
Panel: data teams in Canadian banks — Marcus Bell, Kenji Watanabe
